points.quote: Different assignments will have different instructions on whether and how you can use AI, so check your module handbook first.
points.anchor: AI can be used at Oxford Brookes under the following conditions
points.gist: Assignments differ on whether and how AI can be used, so check your module handbook first.

points.quote: When you submit your assignment, include an Acknowledgements section at the very end of your assignment (after the reference list).
points.anchor: AI can be used at Oxford Brookes under the following conditions
points.gist: Include an Acknowledgements section at the very end of the assignment, after the reference list.

points.quote: If you do use AI tools in your assignment, you always need to acknowledge this.
points.anchor: AI can be used at Oxford Brookes under the following conditions
points.gist: Any use of AI tools in an assignment must always be acknowledged.

points.quote: Some subject areas, such as arts, languages, creative writing and others, may have specific requirements, which means using AI tools is inappropriate.
points.anchor: AI can be used at Oxford Brookes under the following conditions
points.gist: Some subject areas, such as arts, languages and creative writing, may have requirements that make AI use inappropriate.

points.quote: Never submit chunks of text produced by AI as your own work. You may be in breach of the academic conduct regulations.
points.anchor: Use AI with CAUTION (a useful acronym)
points.gist: Never submit chunks of AI-produced text as your own work, as this may breach academic conduct regulations.

points.quote: Output from ChatGPT may contain falsified or misrepresented references, which should not be used in your work.
points.gist: ChatGPT output may contain falsified or misrepresented references, which should not be used in your work.

points.quote: Oxford Brookes students and staff have access to the data-secure Microsoft Co-pilot AI chatbot, available through a Microsoft academic institutional licence.
points.gist: Students and staff have access to the data-secure Microsoft Co-pilot chatbot through an institutional licence.

points.quote: However, we do not recommend you upload any confidential or protected data or information because Co-pilot does not comply with Brookes' expectations of good practice with regard to information security.
points.gist: Do not upload confidential or protected data to Co-pilot, which does not comply with Brookes' information security good practice expectations.

points.quote: Google's own privacy notice tells the user not to share anything personal as it has human reviewers and also retains your data for three-years.
points.gist: Google's privacy notice says not to share anything personal, as it has human reviewers and retains data for three years.

points.quote: Do not upload any confidential or protected data or information to Gemini.
points.gist: Do not upload confidential or protected data or information to Gemini.

points.quote: do I have the right to give it to them, is it my information and not someone else's?
points.anchor: Make safe choices when choosing AI software
points.gist: One guiding question before uploading data asks whether you have the right to give it and whether it is your own information.

points.quote: If you are unsure about the data security of any AI tool you would like to use for Oxford Brookes academic practice or professional service, contact info.sec@brookes.ac.uk
points.anchor: Make safe choices when choosing AI software
points.gist: If unsure about an AI tool's data security, contact info.sec@brookes.ac.uk.

points.quote: don't enter anything you wouldn't want a human reviewer to see, or the AI model or software tool to store, use, or distribute.
points.gist: If not confident a tool is safe, don't enter anything you wouldn't want a human reviewer to see or the tool to store, use or distribute.

points.quote: all students at Oxford Brookes are strongly encouraged to complete the 'Use of Artificial Intelligence' section of the Academic Integrity Moodle course
points.gist: All students are strongly encouraged to complete the 'Use of Artificial Intelligence' section of the Academic Integrity Moodle course.
